root.name: ボストン・サイエンティフィック

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Penumbraを買収する合併契約(2026年1月)

source.label: Penumbra 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 14, 2026, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") with Boston Scientific Corporation

source.label: Boston Scientific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On November 15, 2024, we completed our acquisition of 100 percent of the outstanding equity of Axonics, Inc.

companies.name: シルクロード・メディカル

source.label: Boston Scientific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On September 17, 2024, we completed our acquisition of 100 percent of the outstanding equity of Silk Road Medical, Inc.

relations.text: 残りの株式を取得し完全子会社化(2025年4月)
relations.text_en: Bought the remaining shares in April 2025

source.label: Boston Scientific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On April 1, 2025, we completed our acquisition of the remaining shares of Bolt Medical, Inc.

source.label: Boston Scientific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In the first quarter of 2023, we acquired a majority stake investment in Acotec Scientific Holdings Limited (Acotec) and have elected to consolidate their financial statements on a one quarter lag.

source.label: Boston Scientific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 27, 2026, we completed our acquisition of 100 percent of Nalu Medical, Inc.

relations.text: Elutiaの製品を販売する商業パートナー

source.label: Elutia 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: EluPro and CanGaroo are sold through both our internal sales force and independent sales agents and our commercial partner, Boston Scientific Corporation ("Boston Scientific").

relations.text: フランスでボストン・サイエンティフィックのレーザーを独占販売(2024年末で終了)
relations.text_en: Distributed its Lumenis lasers in France under an exclusive deal that ended at end-2024

source.label: EDAP TMS 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: Our distribution agreement with Boston Scientific expired on December 31, 2024, and was not renewed.

relations.text: Nevroが10-Kで、主な競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Nevro names it among major competitors

source.label: Nevro 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Currently, our major competitors are Medtronic, Boston Scientific and Abbott Laboratories, who have obtained regulatory approval for SCS systems.

companies.name: プロセプト・バイオロボティクス

relations.text: PROCEPTが10-Kで、前立腺肥大治療の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: PROCEPT names it the primary device competitor in BPH

source.label: PROCEPT BioRobotics 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our primary medical device competitors for treating BPH are Boston Scientific Corporation and smaller companies that have single products or a limited range of products.

companies.name: メリット・メディカル

relations.text: Merit Medicalが10-Kで、心臓カテーテル分野の主な競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Merit names it among primary cardiac intervention competitors

source.label: Merit Medical 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors in our cardiac intervention market are BD, Teleflex, Medtronic, Abbott Laboratories, Terumo Corporation, Edwards Lifesciences Corporation, Cook Medical, and Boston Scientific.

companies.name: オーケストラ・バイオメッド

relations.text: Orchestra BioMedが10-Kで、心臓カテーテル分野の最も注目すべき競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Orchestra BioMed lists it first among notable interventional cardiology competitors

source.label: Orchestra BioMed 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Regarding Virtue SAB, our most notable competitors in the highly competitive interventional cardiology field include Boston Scientific Corporation, Medtronic plc, Becton Dickinson, Philips N.V., B.

relations.text: NeuroOneが10-Kで、神経の焼灼治療で競合すると挙げる
relations.text_en: NeuroOne expects to compete with it in nerve ablation

source.label: NeuroOne 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: In BVNA, we expect to compete with Boston Scientific and Stryker's BVNA Systems.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
